commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "07bc0aa1a53a55ff920f1f9ef028c8602fcaa182"
git fetch -q origin agent-control
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess

raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/20260904-growbox-stage28a-rf433-codec-host-v1.json"], text=True)
task = json.loads(raw)
subprocess.run(["bash", "-lc", task["commands"][0]], check=True)
path = Path("test/test_rf433_protocol/test_main.cpp")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "#include <cstdio>" not in text:
    text = text.replace("#include <cstdint>", "#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>")
needle = "assert(decoded.estimated_pulse_us == protocolSpec(protocol)->default_pulse_us);"
replacement = "if (decoded.estimated_pulse_us != protocolSpec(protocol)->default_pulse_us) {\n      std::fprintf(stderr, \"RF433_PULSE_MISMATCH protocol=%u estimated=%u default=%u\\n\",\n                   static_cast<unsigned>(protocol),\n                   static_cast<unsigned>(decoded.estimated_pulse_us),\n                   static_cast<unsigned>(protocolSpec(protocol)->default_pulse_us));\n    }"
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit("diagnostic assertion not found")
path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement), encoding="utf-8")
PY
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-stage28a-diagnostic >/dev/null
cmake --build build/host-stage28a-diagnostic --target rf433_protocol_tests -j2 >/dev/null
./build/host-stage28a-diagnostic/rf433_protocol_tests
printf '%s\n' 'STAGE28A_RF433_CODEC_DIAGNOSTIC_OK'
